subject: world_language
concept: Writing a structured multi-paragraph piece (opinion or narrative) in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'write straightforward connected texts' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a multi-paragraph piece using an organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes a structured multi-paragraph opinion or narrative piece in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: piece has clear paragraph structure, connecting words, and stays on topic
misconception_flags: writes disconnected sentences rather than a genuinely structured multi-paragraph piece

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
